words.example: We need more [sustainable] ways to produce food.
words.exampleZh: 我們需要更多永續的糧食生產方式。

words.example: Cars are a major source of carbon [emissions].
words.exampleZh: 汽車是碳排放的主要來源。

words.example: Solar power is a [renewable] energy source.
words.exampleZh: 太陽能是一種可再生能源。

words.example: Turn off the lights to [conserve] electricity.
words.exampleZh: 關燈以節約用電。

words.example: Factories released harmful [pollutants] into the river.
words.exampleZh: 工廠把有害的汙染物排入河中。

words.example: Overfishing has [depleted] the ocean's fish stocks.
words.exampleZh: 過度捕撈已使海洋魚群枯竭。

words.example: The panda's natural [habitat] is shrinking.
words.exampleZh: 貓熊的自然棲息地正在縮小。

words.example: Dinosaurs became [extinct] millions of years ago.
words.exampleZh: 恐龍在數百萬年前就滅絕了。

words.example: Rainforests are rich in [biodiversity].
words.exampleZh: 雨林擁有豐富的生物多樣性。

words.example: The long [drought] destroyed most of the crops.
words.exampleZh: 長期乾旱毀了大部分作物。

words.example: The smartphone was a major [innovation].
words.exampleZh: 智慧型手機是一項重大的創新。

words.example: [Artificial] intelligence is changing how we work.
words.exampleZh: 人工智慧正在改變我們的工作方式。

words.example: Many factories have [automated] their production lines.
words.exampleZh: 許多工廠已將生產線自動化。

words.example: This new heater is more [efficient] than the old one.
words.exampleZh: 這台新暖氣比舊的更有效率。

words.example: Online shopping offers great [convenience].
words.exampleZh: 網購提供了極大的便利。

words.example: Social media users worry about their [privacy].
words.exampleZh: 社群媒體使用者擔心自己的隱私。

words.example: Please turn off all electronic [devices].
words.exampleZh: 請關閉所有電子裝置。

words.example: Students have free [access] to the library's database.
words.exampleZh: 學生可以免費使用圖書館的資料庫。

words.example: Robots can now [interact] with humans naturally.
words.exampleZh: 機器人現在能與人類自然地互動。

words.example: The internet has [transformed] the way we learn.
words.exampleZh: 網路徹底改變了我們學習的方式。

words.example: The world may [run out of] fresh water one day.
words.exampleZh: 有一天世界可能會用完淡水。

words.example: We should [cut down on] plastic bags.
words.exampleZh: 我們應該減少使用塑膠袋。

words.example: Many families [depend on] farming for their income.
words.exampleZh: 許多家庭依靠務農維生。

words.example: This app helps you [keep track of] how much water you use.
words.exampleZh: 這個 app 能幫你記錄自己用了多少水。

words.example: The villagers live [in harmony with] nature.
words.exampleZh: 村民與大自然和諧共處。
